data.name: Escobar Simulator
data.detailed_description:
💀 ESCOBAR SIMULATOR – BUILD YOUR EMPIRE, OR BURN THEIRS

In the heart of Colombia, you start from the slums.
All you’ve got is a single pot, a few seeds, and an unshakable ambition.
But you’re not alone...
You and your friend can build your own cartels in the same city — trade, ally, or declare open war.

Start from nothing, grow, build, fight, and rise.
Every move brings you closer to the top — or six feet under.

🤝 CO-OP EMPIRE

In online co-op mode, each player builds their own warehouse, production line, and cartel network.
Form trade routes, create joint labs, or invade each other’s territories.
Betrayal, alliances, chaos... it’s all in the players’ hands.

🌿 PRODUCTION & EXPANSION

Buy seeds, grow them in pots, and mix ingredients in your labs.
Upgrade your formulas — create high-quality or risky “special batches.”
Expand your facilities, train your workers, and secure your operation.

🏙️ OPEN WORLD: COLOMBIA

A living city full of slums, villas, harbors, gun dealers, and hidden stash houses.
Buy legitimate businesses like barbershops, galleries, or beauty salons to launder your dirty money.
A day-night cycle breathes life into a world where chaos, trade, and ambition never sleep.

🔥 CARTEL WARS

Cartel Fuego (Reds): Aggressive and ruthless — they spread like fire.
Cartel Sombra (Blacks): Silent and calculating — they strike from the shadows.
Seize their bases, steal their resources, or build your empire from scratch.
Every territory is a war for dominance.

💰 TRADE & CHAOS

Sell your products to street dealers or ship them out through the harbor.
Buy properties to launder your cash and expand your reach.
Grow through diplomacy — or burn everything down.

⚙️ FEATURES

🔹 Online Co-op — Build your own cartel in the same city with your friend, or declare war.
🔹 Real-time production and crafting system
🔹 Build and expand your base of operations
🔹 Territory wars between two rival cartels
🔹 Drive vehicles, transport goods, and fight for control
🔹 Open-world sandbox — create your own story
